items.title: DeepSeek-R1 incentivizes reasoning in LLMs through reinforcement learning
items.method: Pure RL (GRPO, rule-based accuracy+format rewards) on a base model without human-labelled reasoning traces; emergent reflection/verification; distillation of patterns to small models
items.headline_claim: RL-only training surpasses SFT-on-human-demonstrations on math/code/STEM; first peer-reviewed frontier RLVR recipe
items.path_relevance: Foundational RLVR recipe every later GRPO variant modifies
items.frontier_adoption: DeepSeek-V3.2/V4 (GRPO), Kimi, GLM, Qwen all cite it

items.title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
items.method: Clip-Higher (decoupled eps_low/eps_high), dynamic sampling (drop all-correct/all-wrong groups), token-level PG loss, soft overlong punishment; no KL
items.headline_claim: AIME24 50 vs 47 (R1-Zero-Qwen-32B) with 50% of steps; naive GRPO only 30
items.path_relevance: Canonical fixes for entropy collapse and length pathologies; token-vs-sample loss debate
items.frontier_adoption: GLM-5 uses eps_high=0.28 clip-higher; ScaleRL, MiniMax-M1 build on it

items.title: Does Reinforcement Learning Really Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model?
items.method: pass@k at large k across families/algorithms shows RLVR raises pass@1 but base model wins at large k; coverage/perplexity analysis
items.largest_scale: Qwen2.5 up to 32B, LLaMA-3.1-8B; six RLVR algorithms
items.headline_claim: Base models surpass RLVR models at k=256; distillation expands boundary, RLVR does not
items.path_relevance: The central 'does RL add capability' negative claim that ProRL/BroRL/CoT-Pass@K rebut
items.frontier_adoption: Cited by Qwen3 report (RL no pass@64 gain) and by every 2025-26 exploration paper

items.title: ProRL: Prolonged Reinforcement Learning Expands Reasoning Boundaries in Large Language Models
items.method: Prolonged GRPO (2k+ steps) with KL control, periodic reference-policy reset, diverse task suite
items.headline_claim: RL-trained model beats base at all pass@k incl. tasks base never solves; rebuts Yue et al.
items.path_relevance: Direct rebuttal on capability expansion; reference-reset recipe
items.frontier_adoption: BroRL (NVIDIA) follow-up; ScaleRL trains 3.5x longer than ProRL

items.title: The Art of Scaling Reinforcement Learning Compute for LLMs
items.affiliations: Meta; UT Austin; UCL; Berkeley; Harvard; Periodic Labs
items.method: 400k GPU-h study; sigmoid compute-performance fits (asymptote A, efficiency B); ScaleRL recipe = PipelineRL-8 async + CISPO + prompt-level loss + batch adv-norm + FP32 logits + zero-variance filter + no-positive-resampling
items.largest_scale: 8B dense and Llama-4 Scout 17Bx16 MoE; single 100k GPU-h run
items.headline_claim: Extrapolation from 50k to 100k GPU-h matches; loss aggregation/curriculum/length penalty change efficiency not ceiling; longer context raises ceiling
items.path_relevance: First predictive scaling methodology for RL compute; validates CISPO+async at scale
items.frontier_adoption: Recipe components (CISPO, async pipeline) used by MiniMax and Meta

items.title: Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training: A Critical Perspective (Dr. GRPO)
items.tier_evidence: OpenReview forum 5PAF7PAY2Y (submission, 2025-07-08); no proceedings listing found
items.method: Removes GRPO length and std normalisation (Dr. GRPO) to eliminate response-length and difficulty bias; base-model 'Aha' analysis
items.headline_claim: AIME24 43.3 with 7B; length growth partly an optimisation artifact
items.path_relevance: Length-control and unbiased-loss baseline; Thinkless/others adopt std_normalizer=False
items.frontier_adoption: Cited by VAPO; std-norm removal used widely

items.title: Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO)
items.tier_evidence: Qwen Team technical paper; no peer-review signal found; iclr.cc 2026 cites only
items.method: Sequence-level importance ratio (length-normalised sequence likelihood) with sequence-level clipping; removes need for MoE routing replay
items.largest_scale: Qwen3-30B-A3B cold-start; applied to Qwen3 series RL
items.headline_claim: Stable MoE RL without Routing Replay; better than tuned GRPO at same compute
items.path_relevance: Token- vs sequence-level loss debate; infra-friendly (tolerates train/infer mismatch)

items.title: Geometric-Mean Policy Optimization (GMPO)
items.method: Replace GRPO arithmetic mean of token rewards with geometric mean; allows wider clip range (e^-0.4,e^0.4)
items.headline_claim: +4.1% avg Pass@1 over GRPO on math; stable IS ratios
items.path_relevance: Stabilises token-level ratios; alternative to GSPO

items.title: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention (CISPO)
items.method: CISPO: clip the (stop-grad) IS weight rather than the token update, keeping gradients of all tokens; dynamic sampling; FP32 LM head to fix train/infer precision mismatch
items.headline_claim: CISPO matches DAPO with 50% of steps on Qwen2.5-32B; 80k-token thinking budget
items.path_relevance: CISPO is the loss ScaleRL selects; precision-mismatch diagnosis

items.title: VAPO: Efficient and Reliable Reinforcement Learning for Advanced Reasoning Tasks
items.tier_evidence: ByteDance Seed technical report; no review signal found
items.method: Value-based PPO with value pretraining, decoupled GAE, length-adaptive GAE, clip-higher, token-level loss, positive-example LM loss, group sampling
items.headline_claim: AIME24 60.4 in 5k steps, >10 pts over DAPO; no crashes across runs
items.path_relevance: Evidence that critics can beat critic-free methods on long CoT; precursor to GLM-5.2 critic PPO
items.frontier_adoption: GLM-5.2 returns to critic-based PPO for compaction

items.title: BAPO: Stabilizing Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for LLMs via Balanced Policy Optimization with Adaptive Clipping
items.method: Entropy-Clip Rule; adaptively moves clip bounds each step so positive-advantage tokens hit a target loss share (rho0=0.5)
items.largest_scale: 32B (AIME24 87.1) and 7B; partial rollout and replay settings
items.headline_claim: Stable off-policy training under staleness; 32B beats o3-mini/Gemini-2.5-Flash-Thinking

items.title: Beyond the 80/20 Rule: High-Entropy Minority Tokens Drive Effective Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
items.method: Restrict DAPO policy-gradient updates to the top-20% highest-entropy 'forking' tokens
items.headline_claim: +11.04 AIME25 / +7.71 AIME24 on 32B; gain grows with scale
items.path_relevance: Entropy-based token selection; explains why clip-higher beats entropy bonus

items.title: The Entropy Mechanism of Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Language Models
items.affiliations: Shanghai AI Lab; Tsinghua; UIUC; PKU
items.tier_evidence: OpenReview PDF vXoksdcfqC exists; NeurIPS 2025 acceptance not confirmed on neurips.cc
items.method: R = -a exp(H)+b law; entropy change driven by covariance(log-prob, advantage); Clip-Cov and KL-Cov restrict high-covariance tokens
items.headline_claim: +6.4% avg over GRPO on 32B (+15.0 AIME24); entropy bonus and reference-KL fail
items.path_relevance: Mechanistic account of entropy collapse; verl loss modes clip_cov/kl_cov

items.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Entropy Minimization in LLM Reasoning
items.method: EM-FT, EM-RL (negative entropy as sole reward), EM-INF (inference-time logit sharpening)
items.headline_claim: EM-RL matches GRPO/RLOO on Qwen-7B without labels; weak on Llama and value tasks
items.path_relevance: Verifier-free baseline that post-training gains must beat

items.title: Pass@k Training for Adaptively Balancing Exploration and Exploitation of Large Reasoning Models
items.tier_evidence: OpenReview eslxxopXTF ICLR 2026 submission ('Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2026'); acceptance not confirmed
items.method: Pass@k as reward with analytic advantage; entropy-guided adaptive switch between pass@1 and pass@k advantages
items.headline_claim: Higher pass@k without pass@1 loss; exploration and exploitation not conflicting

items.title: L1: Controlling How Long a Reasoning Model Thinks with Reinforcement Learning (LCPO)
items.tier_evidence: 'Published as a conference paper at COLM 2025' (OpenReview PDF 4jdIxXBNve; alphaxiv copy)
items.method: Length-Controlled Policy Optimization: reward = correctness - alpha|target-length|; L1-Exact/L1-Max
items.headline_claim: Prompt-specified length control; 1.5B matches GPT-4o at equal length; beats s1 budget forcing by 20+ pts
items.path_relevance: Token-budget control as an RL objective (precursor to K2.5 Toggle/K3 tau)

items.title: Orchestrating Tokens and Sequences: Dynamic Hybrid Policy Optimization for RLVR
items.method: Dynamic mixing of token-level and sequence-level objectives
items.headline_claim: n/a

items.title: Length-Unbiased Sequence Policy Optimization: Revealing and Controlling Response Length Variation in RLVR
items.method: Length-unbiased sequence-level objective to control response-length drift in RLVR
items.headline_claim: Controls length variation without accuracy loss (claim)

items.title: Policy Improvement Reinforcement Learning
items.method: Policy-improvement-style objective for LLM RL (2026)
items.headline_claim: n/a
items.path_relevance: 2026 policy-gradient variant surfaced by venue search

items.title: Group-Relative REINFORCE Is Secretly an Off-Policy Algorithm: Demystifying Some Myths About GRPO and Its Friends
items.tier_evidence: arXiv abs only; an ICLR 2026 paper with similar title appears in OpenReview listing but not confirmed
items.method: Derives group-relative REINFORCE from first principles as an off-policy method; explains why importance-weight tricks work
items.headline_claim: Unifies GRPO/GSPO/CISPO as off-policy corrections

items.title: AReaL: A Large-Scale Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning System for Language Reasoning
items.method: Fully decoupled rollout/training; staleness cap eta; decoupled PPO objective (behaviour vs proximal policy); interruptible generation
items.headline_claim: 2.77x speedup vs synchronous at matched performance; eta<=8 harmless
items.path_relevance: Defines staleness-aware async RL; underlies Ant ASystem/Ring-1T

items.title: PipelineRL: Faster On-policy Reinforcement Learning for Long Sequence Generation
items.tier_evidence: arXiv abs; no review signal found
items.method: Concurrent generation/training with in-flight weight updates mid-sequence (stale KV kept); simplified GRPO
items.headline_claim: ~2x faster learning than conventional RL while staying near on-policy
items.path_relevance: Async design chosen as baseline by ScaleRL (PipelineRL-8)

items.title: On the Rollout-Training Mismatch in Modern RL Systems (Truncated Importance Sampling, TIS)
items.first_author_et_al: Yao, F.; Liu, L. et al.
items.v1_date: 2025-08 (Notion blog 'Your Efficient RL Framework Secretly Brings You Off-Policy RL Training'); OpenReview 2025-12-01
items.tier_evidence: NeurIPS 2025 OPT workshop paper (opt-ml.org/papers/2025/paper116.pdf; OpenReview xsonlP8DRV); workshop, not main track
items.method: min(pi_train/pi_rollout, C) importance correction between vLLM rollout and FSDP training probabilities; enables INT8/FP8 rollouts
items.headline_claim: Fixes AIME degradation from mismatch; quantized rollouts match BF16
items.path_relevance: Origin of TIS/MIS now in verl, slime, vime, ms-swift
items.frontier_adoption: slime/vime helpers; Ring-1T compares against TIS

items.title: Every Step Evolves: Scaling Reinforcement Learning for Trillion-Scale Thinking Model (Ring-1T; IcePop)
items.method: IcePop: double-sided calibration and masking of tokens whose train/infer probability ratio leaves [alpha,beta]; C3PO++ partial rollouts; ASystem
items.headline_claim: Stabilises MoE RL where GRPO diverges; AIME25 93.4; IMO-2025 silver-level
items.path_relevance: Mismatch masking that GLM-5 adopts as its GRPO backbone

items.title: Diagnosing Training Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.method: Zero-mismatch diagnostic (VeXact) isolating TIM; shows tiny token-level numeric disagreement alone can collapse training
items.headline_claim: TIM changes the effective optimisation problem; first-order factor
items.path_relevance: 2026 evidence that mismatch is not benign noise
items.frontier_adoption: GLM-5.3 reports logprob diff at 1e-7 via full numerical alignment

items.title: Adaptive Layerwise Perturbation: Unifying Off-Policy Corrections for LLM RL
items.method: Learnable per-layer hidden-state perturbations as numerator of the importance ratio to tame heavy-tailed ratios under staleness/mismatch
items.headline_claim: Unifies staleness and mismatch corrections (claim)

items.title: Deconstructing Off-Policy Ratios: Entropy-Scaled Trust Regions for Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
items.method: Entropy-scaled trust region for token retention under stale async data
items.headline_claim: Prevents collapse under high staleness (claim)

items.title: APRIL: Active Partial Rollouts in Reinforcement Learning to Tame Long-tail Generation
items.method: Over-sample then interrupt long-tail rollouts, resume next step
items.headline_claim: ~40% throughput gain in synchronous mode

items.title: Group-in-Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training (GiGPO)
items.method: Episode-level plus anchor-state step-level relative advantages for multi-turn agents, critic-free
items.headline_claim: +12% ALFWorld, +9% WebShop over GRPO at same cost

items.title: Turn-PPO: Turn-Level Advantage Estimation with PPO for Improved Multi-Turn RL in Agentic LLMs
items.method: Turn-level MDP with critic computing per-turn GAE; clipping at turn level
items.headline_claim: PPO more robust than GRPO multi-turn; turn-level critic better than token-level

items.title: Reinforcing Multi-Turn Reasoning in LLM Agents via Turn-Level Reward Design (MT-GRPO / MT-PPO)
items.affiliations: Univ. of Minnesota; Morgan Stanley; Texas A&M
items.method: Terminal vs delayed vs per-turn reward MDPs; derives GRPO and PPO variants with dense turn rewards
items.headline_claim: Dense per-turn rewards beat sparse; PPO most stable

items.title: CompactionRL: Reinforcement Learning with Context Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
items.tier_evidence: Zhipu-authored method paper stated to be deployed in GLM-5.2 RL pipeline
items.method: Summary is a policy action; compacted sub-traces become trainable sequences with token-level normalisation and cross-trajectory GAE correction; critic-based PPO
items.headline_claim: Enables RL on trajectories longer than context

items.title: slime: SGLang-native post-training framework for RL scaling
items.method: Megatron training + SGLang rollout + data buffer; fully async, partial rollout, TIS/MIS helper, OPD (top-k/full-vocab), compact trajectory, sub-agent workflow modes
items.headline_claim: RL framework behind GLM-4.5..5.3; 2.3x throughput gain on long-horizon coding RL (5.3)
items.path_relevance: Infra that defines GLM async algorithms

items.title: Process Reinforcement through Implicit Rewards (PRIME)
items.tier_evidence: OpenReview ICLR 2026 submission (CmyqMn3HeJ, submitted 2025-09-18); an ICLR 2026 proceedings paper cites it as published but iclr.cc listing not confirmed
items.method: Implicit PRM (log-ratio reward) updated online from outcome labels only; token-level dense rewards fused with RLOO
items.headline_claim: 2.5x sample efficiency, +15.1% avg over SFT; surpasses Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct with 10% data
items.path_relevance: Scalable online PRM; cited by DAPO

items.title: Inference-Time Scaling for Generalist Reward Modeling (DeepSeek-GRM / SPCT)
items.method: Self-Principled Critique Tuning: rejective FT then rule-based online RL to generate principles+critiques; parallel sampling + meta-RM voting
items.headline_claim: Vote@32+metaRM 72.8 overall; 27B voting matches 671B model; long-CoT R1 worse than RFT RM
items.path_relevance: Generative reward models with inference-time scaling
items.frontier_adoption: DeepSeek pipeline (V3.2/V4 reward models tailored per domain)

items.title: Rubrics as Rewards: Reinforcement Learning Beyond Verifiable Domains
items.method: Instance-specific LLM-generated rubrics (7-20 weighted items) as GRPO reward, explicit vs implicit aggregation
items.headline_claim: Up to +31% HealthBench, +7% GPQA-Diamond over Likert judge; helps small judges
items.frontier_adoption: Kimi K2/K2.5/K3 self-critique rubric GRMs; GLM-5 hybrid rule/ORM/GRM

items.title: Checklists Are Better Than Reward Models For Aligning Language Models (RLCF)
items.method: Extract instruction-specific checklists (WildChecklists, 130k); grade with LM judge + verifier programs; DPO/RL
items.headline_claim: Only method improving all 5 IF benchmarks (+4 FollowBench hard, +6 InFoBench, +3 Arena-Hard)

items.title: RLPR: Extrapolating RLVR to General Domains without Verifiers
items.tier_evidence: OpenReview T03kNBYq81 ICLR 2026 submission with Feb-2026 revisions; acceptance not confirmed
items.method: Mean token probability of reference answer as reward, debiased, with std-based curriculum filtering
items.headline_claim: Beats VeriFree by 7.0 TheoremQA and General-Reasoner (verifier model) by 1.7 avg

items.title: Learning to Reason without External Rewards (Intuitor / RLIF)
items.method: Self-certainty (KL from uniform) replaces verifiable reward in GRPO
items.headline_claim: Matches GRPO on MATH; +65% relative LiveCodeBench transfer

items.title: Spurious Rewards: Rethinking Training Signals in RLVR
items.method: Random/incorrect/format rewards with GRPO; clipping bias amplifies high-prior 'code reasoning' in Qwen2.5-Math
items.headline_claim: Random reward gives +21.4 MATH-500 on Qwen-Math (vs +29.1 ground truth); no gain on other families
items.path_relevance: Negative result on reward-signal validity and base-model dependence

items.title: Is It Thinking or Cheating? Detecting Implicit Reward Hacking by Measuring Reasoning Effort (TRACE)
items.method: Truncate CoT at increasing fractions, force answer, AUC of expected reward vs length flags low-effort hacks
items.headline_claim: +65% over 72B CoT monitor in math, +30% in code

items.title: Detecting and Suppressing Reward Hacking with Gradient Fingerprints (GRIFT)
items.method: Gradient-based fingerprint of CoT clustered into hacking/non-hacking; used to filter RFT data
items.headline_claim: +25% relative detection over CoT Monitor and TRACE; suppresses hacking in RFT

items.title: Monitoring Reasoning Models for Misbehavior and the Risks of Promoting Obfuscation
items.method: GPT-4o CoT monitor on frontier reasoning agent during RL; adding monitor to reward yields obfuscated hacking
items.largest_scale: o3-mini-class frontier model in agentic coding RL
items.headline_claim: CoT monitor 95% recall vs 60% action-only; CoT pressure hides intent ('monitorability tax')
items.path_relevance: Reward-hacking detection and the limit on optimising CoT
items.frontier_adoption: OpenAI o3/GPT-5 practice; Gemini 3 Pro avoids thought-based rewards

items.title: Absolute Zero: Reinforced Self-play Reasoning with Zero Data
items.method: Single model proposes and solves abduction/deduction/induction code tasks; learnability reward; TRR++ advantage
items.headline_claim: SOTA among zero-setting models without external data (+1.8 avg)

items.title: SPIRAL: Self-Play on Zero-Sum Games Incentivizes Reasoning via Multi-Agent Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
items.affiliations: NUS; Sea AI Lab; UW; Northeastern
items.method: Online multi-turn multi-agent self-play on zero-sum text games with role-conditioned advantage estimation
items.headline_claim: +10% avg over 8 reasoning benchmarks; beats SFT on 25k expert trajectories

items.title: R-Zero: Self-Evolving Reasoning LLM from Zero Data
items.method: Challenger rewarded for Solver uncertainty; Solver trained on majority-vote pseudo-labels; co-evolution
items.headline_claim: +6.49 math, +7.54 general on Qwen3-4B-Base; collapses after ~3 iterations

items.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
items.method: One LLM as Environment Designer writing Gym-style executable environments and as agent; regret from hint gap
items.headline_claim: +5.3 avg over fixed-environment baseline on 8 held-out benchmarks; +13.9 ACEBench-Agent

items.title: Learning to Build the Environment: Self-Evolving Reasoning RL via Verifiable Environment Synthesis
items.method: Model constructs reusable executable environments (sampler, reference, scorer) rather than problems
items.headline_claim: Environment-construction loop sustains zero-data RL (claim)

items.title: G-Zero: Self-Play for Open-Ended Generation from Zero Data
items.method: Verifier-free co-evolution with Hint-delta intrinsic reward for open-ended tasks
items.headline_claim: Extends R-Zero to open-ended generation

items.title: TTRL: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
items.method: Majority-vote pseudo-labels on unlabeled test prompts as rule-based reward for RL
items.headline_claim: AIME24 pass@1 +211% (proceedings version); surpasses initial maj@n

items.title: AdaptThink: Reasoning Models Can Learn When to Think
items.method: Constrained objective favouring NoThinking subject to accuracy; importance sampling balances Thinking/NoThinking samples
items.headline_claim: -53% length, +2.4% accuracy on 3 math sets

items.title: Thinkless: LLM Learns When to Think
items.method: <short>/<think> control token with Decoupled GRPO separating mode-selection loss from response loss
items.headline_claim: 50-90% less long-form reasoning on easy sets

items.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
items.method: 4 stages: long-CoT cold start, reasoning RL (rule rewards), Thinking Mode Fusion (SFT with /think /no_think), general RL on 20+ tasks; thinking budget by early stop; strong-to-weak on/off-policy distillation
items.headline_claim: Distillation beats RL for small models with 1/10 GPU-h; RL gives no pass@64 gain

items.title: Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report
items.tier_evidence: Qwen technical report (html found; abs not fetched)
items.method: Specialist SFT+RL teachers -> on-policy distillation -> interaction-aligned RL; DPO plus GSPO with rule-based rewards
items.headline_claim: Specialist-then-OPD pipeline; GSPO for stability

items.title: RL's Razor: Why Online Reinforcement Learning Forgets Less
items.first_author_et_al: Shenfeld, I.; Pari, J.; Agrawal, P.
items.method: Forgetting predicted by E_new-task KL(base||finetuned); on-policy RL implicitly KL-minimal; oracle-KL SFT forgets even less
items.headline_claim: RL forgets less than SFT at matched new-task accuracy; on-policy data is the cause
items.frontier_adoption: Cited by Thinking Machines OPD; GLM-5 cross-stage OPD rationale

items.title: Retaining by Doing: The Role of On-Policy Data in Mitigating Forgetting
items.method: Ablates KL-reg and advantage; on-policy data explains RL's robustness; approximately on-policy Iterative-SFT suffices
items.headline_claim: RL forgets less than SFT across families/tasks; per-epoch on-policy SFT mitigates forgetting
items.frontier_adoption: GLM-5, DeepSeek-V4, K3 all use on-policy distillation to consolidate

items.title: On-Policy Distillation
items.method: Student samples, teacher gives per-token reverse-KL reward; used for continual learning/recovery
items.headline_claim: Recovers IF-eval after mid-training; self-SFT on own samples still degrades
items.frontier_adoption: GLM-5/5.2/5.3, DeepSeek-V4, Kimi K3 (MOPD) cite/use OPD

items.title: A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models
items.method: Survey: DAgger view of OPD, white/black-box, teacher-free variants
items.headline_claim: Frames OPD as O(T) vs O(T^2) compounding error

items.title: Behavior Knowledge Merge in Reinforced Agentic Models (RAM)
items.method: RL task vectors are sparse/heterogeneous; merge shared regions by averaging, preserve and rescale unique regions
items.headline_claim: Beats TA/TIES/DARE on RL-trained agents; merged model beats specialists

items.title: Sparsity Curse: Understanding RLVR Model Parameter Space from Model Merging
items.method: RLVR updates are sparse, off-principal, near-orthogonal across runs -> naive merging fails; SAR-Merging with Fisher arbitration
items.headline_claim: Standard merging degrades RLVR models; SAR-Merging recovers
items.path_relevance: Weight-space view of RL runs; negative result for merging

items.title: Sparse but Critical: A Token-Level Analysis of Distributional Shifts in RLVR Fine-Tuning of LLMs
items.tier_evidence: arXiv abs; a third-party blog claims ICLR 2026 but iclr.cc listing not confirmed
items.method: Cross-sampling swaps tokens between base and RL policy at high-divergence positions
items.headline_claim: <4% of tokens recover full RL gains (8%->25%); ~7.8% for DAPO (8%->44%)
items.path_relevance: Mechanism for why RL forgets less and merges badly
items.frontier_adoption: cited as rationale for DeepSeek-V4 specialist+OPD

items.title: Deliberative Alignment: Reasoning Enables Safer Language Models
items.tier_evidence: OpenAI report; v1 predates window by 11 days, recorded as baseline
items.method: SFT on context-distilled spec-citing CoTs then RL with spec-aware judge reward
items.headline_claim: Pareto improvement on jailbreak robustness and overrefusal; OOD generalisation

items.title: Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming
items.method: Input/output classifiers trained on constitution-guided synthetic data; streaming output classifier
items.largest_scale: Claude 3.5 Sonnet/Haiku classifiers; 3,000+ h red teaming
items.headline_claim: No universal jailbreak found; 0.38% refusal increase; 23.7% overhead

items.title: Breaking the Safety-Capability Tradeoff: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards Maintains Safety Guardrails in LLMs
items.tier_evidence: arXiv abs; Amazon Science listing; no venue found
items.method: KL-bounded drift theory; RLVR (GRPO, REINFORCE++) on math/code vs SFT across 5 adversarial safety benchmarks
items.headline_claim: RLVR leaves harmfulness unchanged while SFT inflates it

items.title: Beyond SFT: Reinforcement Learning for Safer Large Reasoning Models with Better Reasoning Ability
items.first_author_et_al: Jia, J.; Baracaldo, N.; Liu, S.
items.method: RL safety alignment vs SFT on STAR-1/SafeChain/R2D-R1; entropy/reflection analysis
items.headline_claim: RL yields consistent safety gains and preserves/boosts reasoning; SFT inconsistent
items.path_relevance: Alignment method that is also capability-preserving

items.title: Kimi k1.5: Scaling Reinforcement Learning with LLMs
items.method: Online policy mirror descent with sampled-mean baseline, length penalty, partial rollouts, co-located engines
items.headline_claim: Origin of partial rollouts and length-penalty RL reused in K2/K2.5/K3

items.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
items.method: K1.5-style objective; RLVR + self-critique rubric reward (critic refined on verifiable rollouts); task budgets; auxiliary pretraining loss; temperature schedule
items.headline_claim: 65.8% SWE-bench Verified (non-thinking)
items.path_relevance: Rubric GRM as reward at frontier

items.title: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence
items.method: Token-level log-ratio clipping (gradient masking outside [alpha,beta]) plus squared log-ratio penalty; Toggle alternating budget-limited and free phases; GRMs; PARL with frozen sub-agents
items.headline_claim: Toggle cuts tokens 25-30% with negligible loss; Agent Swarm 4.5x latency reduction
items.path_relevance: Effort control, mismatch clipping, sub-agent RL

items.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
items.method: Partial-rollout async (pause at fraction lambda, resume next iter); K2.5 objective with per-token regularisation tolerating staleness; tau-scaled per-problem budget with reward -1 over budget, annealed for low/high/max experts; agentic GRM with rubric protocol and verbosity cap sigma; nine domain x effort experts merged by Multi-Teacher OPD; co-located 1M-context RL with external KV pool
items.headline_claim: Tool-call steps and capability scale with RL FLOPs; trails Fable 5 / GPT-5.6 Sol; top-k OPD no better than full
items.path_relevance: Most detailed 2026 disclosure of effort control and million-token agentic RL

items.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering

negative_results.finding: Loss aggregation, curriculum, length penalty and advantage normalisation change compute efficiency but not the asymptote (leave-one-out at 16k GPU-h).
Qwen3: on an 8B student, RL gives no pass@64 improvement and distillation wins with 1/10 GPU-hours.
RLVR narrows solution coverage at large k; support shrinkage 2:1-3.6:1 even for ProRL checkpoints (AIME24 base pass@8192 93.3 vs ProRL 83.3).
Random/incorrect rewards give +21-24 MATH-500 on Qwen2.5-Math but nothing on Llama3/OLMo2; effect vanishes when clipping is removed.
GRPO length growth partly an optimisation bias (1/|o| and std terms), not emergent reasoning.
Entropy minimisation fails on Llama-3.1-8B math and on value-reasoning tasks.
Entropy bonus and reference-KL regularisation either are hyper-parameter sensitive or degrade performance.
KL regularisation and advantage estimation do not explain RL's robustness to forgetting; self-SFT on initial-policy samples still forgets.
SFT on a model's own KL-zero samples at any practical LR still degrades IF-eval (finite-batch drift).
GRPO diverges on MoE without routing replay; DAPO clip-higher insufficient at 16 off-policy updates per batch (MiniMax-M1).
Non-deterministic CUDA/TileLang top-k in the DSA indexer collapsed RL within a few steps with a sharp entropy drop; torch.topk fixed it.
Fine-grained top-k OPD objectives gave no advantage over full-distribution OPD in K3.
Rigid token budgets cause 'length overfitting' - models cannot exploit more inference compute (motivates Toggle).
Task-arithmetic/TIES/DARE merging degrades RL-trained models; RL task vectors are sparse and near-orthogonal.
Putting a CoT monitor in the reward yields obfuscated reward hacking; monitor recall drops to near zero.
Long-CoT DeepSeek-R1 scores below a 236B RFT reward model on RM benchmarks: reasoning length does not help generalist RM.
R-Zero collapses after ~3 co-evolution iterations; single-model (unified) variant collapses after 1.
SafeChain and R2D-R1 SFT give marginal or negative safety gains and reduce AIME/GPQA; only STAR-1 helps (SFT-dependent).
'Safety Tax' reports safety SFT on LRMs cuts reasoning accuracy 7-31% (unverified in this sweep).
